<RichColor Color="1,0.9,0.5,1">Welcome to Matriark!</>

This is a stable, long-term Cluster with <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">crossplay-safe mods and plugins</> that enhance gameplay for mature players.

On Matriark you can explore, build, and survive with like-minded adults who value respect, consideration, and zero toxicity.

The founder, <RichColor Color="1,0.2,0.6,1">JustSimply_JJ</>, has been hosting Ark servers since 2021 and self-hosts Matriark solo. She actively keeps the Cluster maintained & updated.

<RichColor Color="0,0.6,1,1">Please review the rules and other helpful info before building and playing on the maps.</>

<RichColor Color="1,0,0,1">Important Tribe Enforcer Info: </>

Tribe is auto created on join and synced across all maps. The Owner should rename the tribe then travel to all maps one time, waiting a few minutes for tribe to show on each map - before inviting members.

<RichColor Color="1,0.9,0.5,1">We hope you enjoy your time with us!</>

Have fun! <3

tab2.text1:
<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">1.</> Be a respectful adult, no exceptions - no toxicity, harassment, or drama.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">2.</> No inappropriate character or tribe names. No variation of human character names.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">3.</> No replacements or handouts for loss due to normal gameplay. Bug-related loss may be reviewed via help ticket and are not guaranteed.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">4.</> Server decisions and settings are not open for debate. Public complaints, arguments, or disruptive behaviour are not permitted. Feedback is collected through polls.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">5.</> Bases: Do not build near other players or public structures. Base limits per map: 1 main base, 1 outpost, public trap, or treehouse, and 1 water pen.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">6.</> Tames: Do not leave tames on breeding, wander, neutral, aggressive, or flee while offline. Wander exception: max 2 snails + 2 dung beetles (caged & neutered). Max 30 tames out while offline, and all tames must be stored at your base.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">7.</> Fair Trades & Breeding: Only clean, un-mutated tames may be traded or bred between Tribes. Trades must not bypass player progression (if in doubt, check engram level). Trading requires compensation, such as tame-for-tame, tames or items exchanged for shop points, resources, or other agreed-upon terms.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">8.</> Map conduct: Turrets must be set to wilds only with medium or low range (×50 damage); clean up structures—no spamming (structure pickup is on); turn off crafting, automation, and breeding stations before extended log-off; do not block resources, explorer notes, artifact caves, or public areas.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">9.</> Max 1 cloning chamber per tribe, per map.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">10.</> Choose tribe members wisely - repeated rule violations may result in a full tribe wipe and ban.

tab4.text1:
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Important Tribe Enforcer Info: </>

Tribe is auto created on join and synced across all maps. The Owner should rename the tribe then travel to all maps one time before inviting members.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Awesome Teleporters:</> Act as teleporter and transmitter.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">SCS Cryopods:</> Tames keep their inventory in SCS cryopods, allows easy transfer of element and boss items between maps.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Plugins:</> Prevent stealing and griefing; unlock storage box for player trades.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">The Matriark in-game shop:</> Accessed via the radial menu and offers starter kits, potions, tames, and resources. Loonies are earned by playing only.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Shop Info:</>
• Most shop items require a certain level to purchase
• Dino unlocks typically match saddle engram level
• When selecting an item, the right side shows Min-Level (required level to purchase)
• If Min-Level is not shown, the item can be purchased at any level

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Shiny!:</>The Shiny! tracker is disabled. All Shiny! dinos are level 210 - use der dino finder via your inventory map tab to help locate them.

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Lethal Decay:</> Active, all structure tiers are 21 days & tames 14 days before decay.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
tab4.text2:
Companion Whistle Dump (Workaround)

Step 1: Empty your entire inventory into storage (gear, cosmetics, hotbar — leave only the whistles)

Step 2: Travel to Aberration and spawn at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 3: Pull your implant (R2 on the implant)

Step 4: Respawn again at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 5: Use the Awesome Teleporter or Transmitter to return to previous map.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
